description: One Zone's slots as an explicit 2D matrix a UI can iterate and paint: rows are Levels, columns are (Aisle, Bay) pairs in walk order.

zone.description: A behavioral classification scoped to a Site, bundling the Area and Zone code segments into one aggregate.

zoneId.description: `SITE-AREA-ZONE` — the first three segments of every LocationCode inside it.

siteCode.description: The Site this zone is scoped to.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.

hazmat.description: Whether the zone is rated for hazardous materials.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.

bayPitchM.description: The zone's effective bay pitch (ADR-0017): the explicit override when one was set at registration, else the service default (1.2 m). Used only by the travel graph's estimated-distance fallback when aisle centreline geometry is missing.

levelPitchM.description: The zone's effective level pitch (ADR-0017): the explicit override when one was set at registration, else the service default (1.5 m). Used only by the travel graph's estimated vertical spacing between adjacent levels.

columns.description: (Aisle, Bay) pairs in aisle SequenceHint order.

items.description: One (Aisle, Bay) column of a zone grid, carrying the aisle's walk-order hint so a renderer can label or space columns by travel order.

levels.description: The distinct level segments present, ascending — one per row.

rows.description: One row per level, each index-aligned with `columns`.

items.description: One Level of the grid. `cells` is index-aligned with the grid's `columns`.

level.description: The level segment this row represents.

cells.description: One entry per grid column, in the same order. A `null` entry is a gap in the rack.

items.description: The slots at one (Aisle, Bay, Level) coordinate — usually several, one per Position. `null` instead of this object means a gap in the rack.

positions.description: The slots at this coordinate, ordered by position.

items.description: One slot inside a grid cell.

position.description: The position segment — the slot's left-to-right place on the level.

role.description: What a location on the map is FOR (ADR-0016). Storage is the default and only role that existed before this ADR; the rest cover non-storage functional locations that previously had no place on the map at all.
